name: Circle Spinner Wipe
description: A circular ring that progressively reveals its stroke clockwise like a loading progress arc

variations.name: default
variations.description: Two concentric rings where the foreground ring wipes clockwise from 0% to 100% over the background track

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the animated wipe ring

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Color of the background track ring

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width of the rings in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
